build_CLIP_model_from_state_dict: build a CLIP model from a PyTorch state dict using build_model
encode_image_features: encode an image tensor into normalized feature vectors using CLIP encode_image
encode_text_features: encode tokenized text into normalized feature vectors using CLIP encode_text
compute_image_text_similarity: compute cosine similarity logits between images and text using CLIP forward
convert_model_weights_to_fp16: convert a CLIP model parameters to fp16 using convert_weights
